# MiniTool

> MiniTool is a comprehensive software suite providing disk management, data recovery, backup solutions, and system optimization tools for Windows PCs and servers.

MiniTool offers a range of professional-grade utilities spanning partition management, system backup, data recovery, PDF editing, and PC optimization. The product lineup serves both individual users with free versions and enterprises with advanced server editions.

## Key Topics

- Partition Wizard
- ShadowMaker
- Power Data Recovery
- Disk Management
- Data Recovery
- Backup Software
- Windows Support
- System Optimization
- Bootable Media
- Disaster Recovery
- NTFS
- SSD Management
- Windows Server
- File Recovery
- Data Protection

## Partition Management

- [MiniTool Partition Wizard](https://www.minitool.com/partition-manager): Main product page for disk and partition management solutions
- [Partition Wizard Free](https://www.minitool.com/partition-manager/partition-wizard-home.html): Free version of Partition Wizard for Windows disk management and optimization
- [Partition Wizard Professional](https://www.minitool.com/partition-manager/partition-wizard-professional.html): Professional edition with dynamic disk manager features for advanced users
- [Partition Wizard Server](https://www.minitool.com/partition-manager/partition-wizard-server.html): Server edition for Windows Server disk and partition management
- [Partition Wizard Bootable](https://www.minitool.com/partition-manager/partition-wizard-bootable.html): Bootable edition for portable partition management without OS dependency

## Backup & System Recovery

- [MiniTool ShadowMaker](https://www.minitool.com/backup): Professional backup software for Windows system backup and disaster recovery
- [ShadowMaker Free](https://www.minitool.com/backup/system-backup.html): Free backup software for Windows system and file backup with core features
- [ShadowMaker Pro](https://www.minitool.com/backup/shadowmaker-pro.html): Professional backup and disaster recovery solution for Windows 11/10/8/7
- [ShadowMaker Business](https://www.minitool.com/backup/server-backup.html): Business edition for Windows Server backup and business continuity
- [ShadowMaker Bootable](https://www.minitool.com/backup/bootable.html): Bootable backup edition for WinPE-based backup and recovery operations

## Data Recovery

- [MiniTool Power Data Recovery](https://www.minitool.com/data-recovery-software): Data recovery software for Windows and Mac file and drive recovery
- [Power Data Recovery Free (Windows)](https://www.minitool.com/data-recovery-software/free-for-windows.html): Free recovery tool for Windows deleted files and drive recovery
- [Power Data Recovery Personal](https://www.minitool.com/data-recovery-software/pro-for-windows.html): Personal edition for Windows file recovery with enhanced features
- [Power Data Recovery Business](https://www.minitool.com/data-recovery-software/power-data-recovery-commercial.html): Business license for server and enterprise-level data recovery
- [Stellar Data Recovery for Mac](https://www.minitool.com/data-recovery-software/free-for-mac.html): Data recovery solution for macOS file and disk recovery

## System Utilities & Optimization

- [MiniTool System Booster](https://systembooster.minitool.com): PC optimization and tune-up software for Windows performance enhancement
- [MiniTool VPN](https://vpn.minitool.com): VPN solution for Windows privacy protection and IP masking
- [Stellar Photo Repair](https://utilities.minitool.com/data-repair/photo-repair-software.html): Photo repair tool for corrupted JPEG and RAW image recovery

## Document & File Management

- [MiniTool PDF Editor](https://pdf.minitool.com): All-in-one PDF editing software for creation, editing, conversion, and protection
